title: parapolystichum acutum
intro: Parapolystichum acutum, commonly known as the Chinese maiden's hair fern, is a type of flowering plant in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is a vascular plant that belongs to the fern group. This plant has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Parapolystichum acutum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant and immunomodulatory effects.
